what: the unit suite is green on the base and only covers the accepting path; the requirement is the CLI's real process behaviour (exit code 2/3 and which stream carries the error)
expectedOutcome: hidden PASS only when the real process exits nonzero on a rejected config AND writes the errors to stderr with an empty stdout; a candidate that fixes the exit code but leaves the report on stdout is caught
requirements: a valid config exits 0 with 'config <name>.json: ok' on stdout and an empty stderr
a config with warnings exits 0, prints the ok line and one 'warning: <field>: <reason>' line per warning on stdout
an invalid config exits 2, writes nothing to stdout, and prints one 'error: <field>: <reason>' line per error on stderr
a warned config run with --strict exits 2 and reports the warnings as errors on stderr
--strict moves warnings into errors rather than dropping them
a missing, unreadable or non-JSON config file exits 3 with an error on stderr and nothing on stdout
a missing required argument or an unknown argument exits 3 with an error and the usage block on stderr
validate(config, { strict }) returns { errors, warnings } with every entry shaped '<field>: <reason>'
